identification: Three Penfolds reds: St Henri Claret Special Vintage 1969 (1 pint 6 fl oz, Auldana Cellars label) and two Penfolds Coonawarra Claret Bin 128 Vintage 1973 750ml. Labels aged, one 1973 label has a small mark, fill levels look good (high shoulder) in photo. Photo confirms all three vintages.

entries.note: From local comps database (comps.py). Title is St Henri Claret Special Vintage 1987, a much younger vintage than 1969; database text also says Shiraz 2002, so identification is loose. Page not opened by me. Guide only, AUD so no rate.
